metadata.title: Clicked like an office worker on lunch break and somehow got 2 kills? Valorant WTF
metadata.description:
Me: half-asleep clicking madly
Enemies: probably uninstalling to question reality
Valorant said ‘Here’s 2 kills, because why not?’
If your aim’s a mess but kills drop, you get me

Tap if your aim’s a total mess but Valorant still hands out kills!

#valorant #luckykills #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
